description: The mandatory negative test, in the form Shape C admits. A control-plane adapter registers no hook and installs no script, so there is no process for an unbound session to start: the sidecar exists only because Overlord launched it, and it exits before any I/O when the scope gate finds no channel. What can be asserted statically is that the gate is the first thing it does and that it has no fallback to a broader credential.
